schools.name: Harvard
schools.scope_note: Combines an HGSE student policy with university-wide Provost guidance; the HGSE-specific requirements are not presented as rules binding every Harvard school.

cells.note: Using AI to produce assignment content is barred absent instructor permission; the rule is also explicitly paralleled to having another person do the work.
cells.evidence: Unless otherwise specified by your instructor, it is a violation of the HGSE Academic Integrity Policy to use generative AI to create all or part of an assignment for a course (e.g., a paper, memo, presentation, or short response) and submit it as your own.
